subtitle.en: Ignacio has posted the conclusion of his irradiance-caching series and released the source code.
subtitle.zh: Ignacio 发完了他的辐照度缓存系列，并放出了源代码。

translator.note: 归档里开头两段原文就是两行「...」，照原样保留为两个段落。

blocks.en: Ignacio has posted [the conclusion of his series on irradiance caching](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2014/07/irradiance-caching-continued/) -- at long last! -- and released the source code.
blocks.zh: Ignacio 发出来了[他辐照度缓存系列的最后一篇](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2014/07/irradiance-caching-continued/)——真是千呼万唤！——并且放出了源代码。

blocks.en: This code is a significant chunk of what makes lighting in The Witness as nice as it is.
blocks.zh: 这份代码是让《The Witness》的光照如此出色的重要组成部分。
